status: Official paper-linked benchmark copper/footprints with explicitly adapted pin and wire technology; not a replica of Fig. 8 hardware.
adaptations: High-side dies D3/D4 use 180-degree pin orientation to face the central gate trace.
Bond origins use MOSFET.part physical pad centers instead of the legacy script's point placeholders.
Trace landings follow die-pin x coordinates, enforcing vertical Manhattan wires.
Physical trace landing pads are 0.5 mm squares; the legacy 0.25 mm markers are symbolic points.
Wire heights are assumed 1 mm because the source technology file does not specify them.
Power and gate wire diameters are 0.3 and 0.1 mm; conductivities follow the paper.
The source 0.835 mm ceramic gap is retained, not replaced by the Fig. 8 vehicle's 0.635 mm value.
Frequency is explicitly 100 kHz; device links are near-ideal for packaging-parasitic extraction.
Backside copper is included as an electrically floating passive plane.
